description: This PHP class 'SaveJobTitleController' is a web controller responsible for handling the pre-render step of a view related to saving or editing a job title within the OrangeHRM system. It manages the setup of a Vue.js component by configuring properties based on the request attributes and service configurations.

classes.name: SaveJobTitleController
classes.description: A controller class extending AbstractVueController, responsible for preparing the Vue component with appropriate properties before rendering the view for saving or editing job titles.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and configures the Vue component based on request attributes and configuration service data, setting properties related to job title ID and file upload constraints.
